articleTitle: Wind power prediction based on a convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: Wind power has recently become one of the most important renewable energy sources due to its advantages including less pollution, flexible investment, short construction period and less land occupation. The uncertainty of the speed and direction of wind causes wind power prediction to be extremely difficult to wind power generation. The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has the advantage of big data processing. CNN addresses data in the form of a two-dimensional matrix and is widely applied in the field of image processing. This paper applies CNN to wind power prediction. With historical data of wind power from a wind farm as input, this paper sets and trains the CNN model in MATLAB. The results of the prediction prove the feasibility of CNN applied to regression prediction.

articleTitle: An 800 mA load current LDO with wide input voltage range
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: A low-dropout regulator (LDO) with 800 mA load current with wide range input voltage is designed and proposed in this paper. The designed LDO includes two cascaded LDOs. The first one uses a p-type of DMOS power transistor to convert a wide input voltage (3.9 to 20 V) to a stable output voltage of 3 V, which provides a supply voltage for other circuits. The second LDO is designed to achieve a large load current by utilizing a high current driving capability of NPN power transistor. To achieve a high slewing rate, both PMOS and NMOS input-pair amplifiers with a push-pull output stage are adopted. Through the Kelvin connection of external resistors, the output voltage can be adjusted to a different value. The typical output voltage is 2.5 V in this study, and the simulation results show that the designed LDO has good transient response. The measurements demonstrate the output voltage of 2.5 V is stable with a 15μF output capacitor when an input voltage from 3.9 V to 20 V is applied. With a full output load range from 0 to 800 mA, the proposed LDO obtains a line regulation of 0.5093 mV/V and a load regulation of 0.046 mV/mA. The total active chip size is approximately 1.42 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with 20V/0.25μm CMOS process.

articleTitle: Simulation of electric field around typical defects in 110kV XLPE power cable joints
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: Cable joint is the most vulnerable part of the power cable system. Defects in cable joints can cause intensification of local electric field and thus may lead to partial discharge (PD). Long time PD will degrade the insulation performance of cable joints and eventually lead to insulation failure. This work first analyzed the typical defects in 110kV cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) power cable joints. Secondly, to simulate the electric field around the defects, the three-dimensional (3D) model of the cable joint is constructed in the COMSOL Multiphysics software. Finally, the 3D electric field distribution around these typical defects are simulated by the finite element method (FEM) and the influence of different defects on the electric field intensification is analyzed.

articleTitle: Quantitative assessment of electric safety protection for electric vehicle charging equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: By the rapid development of EV industry, electric safety accidents occurred sometimes, charging equipment and power battery are two main aspects. At present, the assessment of electrical safety is still in the level to meet the relevant standards and lack of complete assessment method. In this paper, according to the electric safety protection of electric vehicle charging equipment, a new method based on synthetic weight is proposed. This method quantifies the abstract ability of electrical safety and a real charging equipment is tested in order to verify the validity of the evaluation index.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis system of electric vehicle power battery based on OBD technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: In this paper, according to the severity of the fault of the battery system and the impact of different faults on the vehicle and the driver, the generation of battery system fault code based on OBD fault diagnosis protocol is completed, and the transmission of the fault code based on CAN bus and the application of OBD protocol in electric vehicle is realized. Experimental results show that the battery fault diagnosis expert system can run correctly in the battery management system hardware platform. It can keep the battery voltage, current, temperature and SOC parameters in a reasonable range. Timely and accurate diagnosis of the fault of the power battery ensure the safety and reliability of the battery system's operation.

articleTitle: A self-activating irrigation technology designed for a smart and futuristic farming
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: The “smart” farming tries to attract Filipinos to be involved in agriculture by opening a window on how the old-aged practice of farming integrates the application of modern technologies. Catalyzing a device embedded with sensor technologies such as the soil moisture sensor that can identify the water volume content of soil which when incorporated in the irrigation management strategy may result in the conservation of costly water irrigation, a humidity sensor that can descry dry presence of water in air and a self-activating irrigation that will release enough amount of water needed by the soil for cultivating healthy plants. The future scenes for plant growers would be a high-tech and automatic irrigation that would lead to competitiveness in the market. The possible deployment of the proposed project in the agricultural lands in the country would be a big leap in water conservation and would be a promising solution in the future water scarcity.

articleTitle: The application of double arms SCARA robot for deburring of PCB support plate
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: Current manufacturing processes use robots for obtaining higher accuracy, higher precision, and fast response in the process. Deburring is one of important processes in metal forming processes. This research is aimed to design double arms SCARA robot for deburring process. The robot motion analysis used SolidWorks Motion Analysis in order to obtain the rotational angles of motors of the robot arms. In the motion analysis, two robot arms have identical rotational angles. They can also work parallel to each other as prescribed by users. The rotational angles were used to control the robot movement by using teach pendant method. The result shown that robot can be deburred two of the 10 holes of PCB board within 60 second and reduced manufacturing time, which is 2 times of work of human workforce.

articleTitle: Traveling wave fault location based on wavelet and improved singular value difference spectrum
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: The single terminal fault location method is based on the wavelet modulus maximum to obtain the time difference that the fault traveling wave reach the same measuring point, which can calculate the fault distance, but the error of the actual results is relatively large. In this paper, a traveling wave fault location method based on Wavelet and improved singular value difference spectrum is proposed. Firstly, the delay step of the time series is determined by the autocorrelation function of the fault traveling wave signal, and construct the new Hankel matrix. Secondly, the singular value decomposition method is used to get the new matrix singular value number, and the number of effective singular values is calculated by the singular value difference spectral, the singular values are reconstructed to get the de-noising signals. At last, using the modulus maximum to get the changed frequency, the fault distance can be calculated according to the relationship between the frequency and the fault distance. The simulation experiments demonstrate that the error of the proposed method is small and the accuracy is higher.

articleTitle: HVDC bidirectional power flow using solid state transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: With the development of a hybrid system, flexible AC transmission system (FACTS) and high voltage direct current (HVDC) system are using to provide the control technique in the hybrid power system. In distributed power generation systems, the DC networks have more importance to handle the problem related to the DC power flow control in DC networks. Interline Power Flow Controller (IPFC) is a FACTS device used to control power flow in multi-line and parallel transmission lines. In this paper, a new topology has been proposed to control DC power flow through an Interline DC Power flow controller (IDCPFC) with Solid State Transformer (SST). In the proposed method, the boost converter is used to achieve increased output voltage from the input voltage and its current is regulated through the duty cycle of the converter. The control algorithm of the proposed technique is smooth and easy to deploy. To justify the topology, simulation results of proposed topology are investigated in this paper through the Simulink.

articleTitle: Unified control architecture for 5G convergence network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: Future data traffic is expected to be tremendously increased. The huge traffic is necessary to be supported by various types of access networks rather than a single type of access network. The 5G network assumes fixed wireline and WiFi as access technologies as well as a new 5G Radio Access Technology (RAT). In this paper, we discuss a unified control architecture to provide access control and session control using a common signaling scheme in 5G. The proposed unified control minimizes access network dependency. The discussion of access control and session control reveals our study on their functionalities. Although the proposed architecture is not fully comply with 3GPP developing standard, our study on access control and session control reveals their functionalities.

articleTitle: Tunable electromagnetic interference shield using periodic graphene-based structures in the terahertz regime
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: The demand for band broadening in communication devices has caused designing electronic circuits to draw numerous attentions among the research community. Recently, designing and implementation of electronic circuits have been developed in the THz and optical frequencies to achieve ultrafast responses. Thus, electromagnetic interference shields due to its protection effects against disturbances caused by adjacent elements have emerged as a vital issue in THz circuit designing. In this paper, two types of electromagnetic shields are proposed in the THz regime and shielding effectiveness calculated by using transmission line model. Comparisons indicate that the results obtained from the proposed method are in high accordance with those of CST-MWS commercial software.

articleTitle: Concurrent high-efficiency tri-band GaN power amplifier with continuous class-E mode
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This paper presents a concurrent high-efficiency tri-band power amplifier with the continuous class-E mode. The continuous class-E power amplifier can perform high-efficient concurrently at some operational frequencies by manipulating the fundamental and second harmonic impedances of the transistor. After selected the design parameters of the proposed tri-band power amplifier, the output and input microstrip lines matching network are directly optimizing by the mixed particle swarm optimization-genetic algorithm, which can accelerate the convergence speed of the matching networks comparing with the standard particle swarm optimization algorithm. To verify the proposed design methodology, a tri-band power amplifier at 1.7 GHz, 2.6 GHz and 3.0 GHz is designed. The measured results show that the fabricated power amplifier delivers more than 40 dBm output power with 62%, 64% and 64% PAE at 1.7 GHz, 2.6 GHz and 3.0 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Design of dielectric resonator cavity filter with double-CT to control TZs
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: A new couple approach based on CT cross-coupling is proposed. Through changing size and location of the structure (U-type rod), while rotating the angle of the feeding probes which extended along ring dielectric resonators, transmission zeros (TZs) can be generated in high band or low band according to specific requirements. To prove the proposed idea, two six-order bandpass filters based on double-CT are designed and simulation. Good agreement is obtained between technique target and simulated results, showcasing good performance such as high out-of-band rejection and low return loss in the passband.

articleTitle: The balancing system of super capacitor based on active clamped forward converter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: Super capacitor energy storage system(SCESS) with high power, long life, wide operating temperature range, is widely used in industrial applications. The balancing system is needed to ensure the operation safety of the SCESS. In this paper, the balancing system based on active clamped forward converter is designed. The active clamped forward converter is based on synchronous rectifier technology with peak current control strategy which can output low voltage, high current with high efficiency. The converter with 2.5 V output voltage, 20A output current is designed and realized, the efficiency of which can reach 90%. Then the designed converter is used in super capacitor balancing system, and the control strategy of the balancing system is studied. The experimental results show that the proposed super capacitor balancing system can achieve the balancing of super capacitors.

articleTitle: Acceleration-based algorithm for long monitoring the micro motions on a stationary subject using UWB radar
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: Long term monitoring of human micro activities along breathing is still considering challenging in noncontact vital sign measurements. A new detection method based on acceleration of micro-motion displacements is proposed through ultra-wideband radar. Micro motions responses due to different physiological conditions, including random body movement, coughing and speaking are quantitatively detected. Comparing the standard deviations of the proposed acceleration-based method and traditional velocity-based one, coughing produces the greatest changes but speaking the lowest, and the former performs better by highlighting the characteristic changes among those micro motions.

articleTitle: A closed-form robust Chinese remainder theorem Based multibaseline phase unwrapping
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: Multibaseline phase unwrapping (PU) is a critical processing procedure of multibaseline synthetic aperture radar interferometry (InSAR). The presence of phase noise makes Chinese remainder theorem (CRT) method not robust enough and inapplicable in practical cases. In this letter, a method based on a closed-form robust Chinese remainder theorem (CFRCRT) is presented to improve the noise robustness of the multibaseline PU. Experimental results prove the effectiveness of CFRCRT method and demonstrate that the CFRCRT method is more robust to noise than the CRT method.

Author Keywords: phase unwrapping (PU) closed-form robust Chinese remainder theorem (CFRCRT)

articleTitle: Dynamic reconstruction of active distribution network with electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: The large-scale electric vehicles access to the distribution network, the randomness and decentralization of the distribution network management put forward new requirements for the transmission line load capacity also launched a challenge. In order to make the distribution network of electric vehicles take safe, economic and stable operation, according to the characteristics of electric vehicles, we use the CLARANS clustering technology according to load similarity in distribution network to simplify load model of EV, the load state of each cluster center is used as the load state of the classification, and the dynamic reconfiguration of the distribution network is transformed into static reconfiguration in multiple time periods. And then the krill-herd algorithm is applied to solve the static reconfiguration of the distribution network. The load data of the EV is built in IEEE 33 node distribution system and this model is simulated and analyzed to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The closed-loop design for Buck Chopper circuit
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: The Chopper Circuits are widely used in practical applications, but the voltage output of open-loop Buck Chopper could not meet application requirements on stability, accuracy and rapidity. Aiming at these existing problems, this paper presents a closed-loop design, which constitutes the negative feedback by adopting incremental PI regulation and PWM control, to obtain stable and accurate output. Meanwhile, the superiority of incremental PI regulation has been also verified through the comparison with the position PI regulation. The experimental outcomes of simulation based on Multisim illustrate that the design would have fully achieved expected results.

articleTitle: A novel T-type dual-band impedance transformer for frequency-relevant complex impedance load
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: A novel three-section transmission line based T-type dual-band impedance transformer (DBIT) with its closed-form design equations is proposed in this paper. The proposed impedance transformer could transform two different complex impedances to a resistive load at two arbitrary real frequencies. A section transmission line is employed to transform the two different complex impedances to the same complex impedance at the two frequencies first. Another section transmission line is utilized to transform the resistive load terminal to an intermediate complex impedance at the two frequencies, which real parts is equal to the real parts of the first section transmission line. The third section opened or shorted transmission line stub is bestowed to cancel the sum susceptance of the first and second transmission line. The proposed method is especially appropriate when the two designated frequencies are far away from each other.

articleTitle: High speed low power true single phase clock CMOS divide by 2/3 prescaler
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: A new true-single-phase-clock (TSPC) divide-by-2/3 prescaler is presented in this work. By merging one of the branches of the TSPC D flip-flops (DFF) and the modified dual-modulus control circuit, we can realize a divide-by-2/3 prescaler with only 5-stage TSPC logic gates and fewer transistors compared with the conventional designs. Analysis shows that the load capacitance at output of the proposed prescaler can be much reduced, and the prescaler can operate as fast as a single TSPC flip-flop when working in the divide-by-3 mode. The proposed prescaler and the recently published works are both simulated in a low power 65nm CMOS process. From the simulation results, it is shown that the proposed divide-by-2/3 prescaler demonstrates the highest power efficiency among the referenced designs.

articleTitle: A utility maximization strategy for the secondary system operation quality optimization of intelligent substation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: At present, the lack of actual operation experience of the intelligent substation secondary system results in indeterminate maintenance strategy, time-consuming and laborious routing inspection, blindness in maintenance work and some other issues. Based on this, a comprehensive evaluation system of the operation quality of the secondary system is realized firstly. Secondly, the utility function is defined, which can quantitatively represent the influence of the index value change on that of the index evaluation value. Thirdly, the threshold of the operation status of the secondary system is determined, according to the results of the evaluation of the secondary system operation quality. Finally, A utility maximization strategy for the secondary system operation quality optimization of intelligent substation is proposed, and a specific example is given to generate a quality improvement scheme. This scheme can reduce the maintenance actions, which will help to develop the arrangements for maintenance tasks. Effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the results of the example.

Author Keywords: threshold of operation status of the secondary system

articleTitle: Multi-resolution modeling based on structure in application of more electric aircraft EMA system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: For saving energy and improving the performance of the airborne systems, modern aircraft increasingly uses electrical energy to replace the current hydraulic, pneumatic energy on the aircraft. The goal of more electric aircraft is to obtain high performance and high efficiency with electric drive equipments to replace mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic equipments directly driven by the original engine. More electric aircraft EMA system is a typical complex nonlinear system, which is the multi-physical field collection system of electrical energy, mechanical energy and thermal energy. In order to solve the problem of system integration simulation, for simulation needs of the system, a multi-resolution modeling technology based on structure is proposed in this paper, taking the multi-electric aircraft EMA system as an example and combining with multi-physical domain modeling technology. For the needs of different simulation problems, selecting the appropriate multi-resolution models can improve the system simulation speed and observe the required signal information.

articleTitle: A practical evaluation method for the operation quality of smart substation secondary equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This paper presents a practical evaluation method for the operation quality of smart substation secondary equipment. The evaluation method includes evaluation index system, evaluation model and evaluation process. Taking full account of the main factors which affect the operation quality of smart substation secondary equipment, the veto index is proposed and a relatively complete evaluation index system is set up; a new evaluation model is proposed considering the characteristics of the veto index, in this evaluation model, the initial weight coefficient of the index is determined by the improved analytic hierarchy process (IAHP), and then it is modified by the variable weight theory; finally, a complete set of evaluation process is proposed. In this paper, the evaluation method is described in detail, and the practicality of the proposed method is further clarified by the example evaluation.

articleTitle: Integrated control to improve vehicle handling and stability based on the control authority of chassis key electronic controller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: An integrated vehicle control system to improve vehicle handling and stability is developed based on the control authority of chassis key electronic control subsystems. First, a quantitative analysis of the control authority and the effective working region of the active front steering (AFS), active braking (AB) and active suspension (AS) subsystems is investigated based upon a full vehicle model. Then, an integrated control strategy is developed according to the control authority and the effective working region of chassis key electronic subsystems. The proposed strategy not only maximizes the benefits that each electronic subsystem offers but also minimizes the interactions between them. Computer simulation results confirm the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed integrated control system and the improvements in vehicle handling and stability.

Author Keywords: control authority and effective working range

articleTitle: Performance analysis of IDS with honey pot on new media broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This research was an experimental analysis of the Intrusion Detection Systems(IDS) with Honey Pot conducting through a study of using Honey Pot in tricking, delaying or deviating the intruder to attack new media broadcasting server for IPTV system. Denial of Service(DoS) over wire network and wireless network consisted of three types of attacks: TCP Flood, UDP Flood and ICMP Flood by Honey Pot, where the Honeyd would be used. In this simulation, a computer or a server in the network map needed to be secured by the inactivity firewalls or other security tools for the intrusion of the detection systems and Honey Pot. The network intrusion detection system used in this experiment was SNORT (www.snort.org) developed in the form of the Open Source operating system-Linux. The results showed that, from every experiment, the internal attacks had shown more threat than the external attacks. In addition, attacks occurred through LAN network posted 50% more disturb than attacks occurred on WIFI. Also, the external attacks through LAN posted 95% more attacks than through WIFI. However, the number of attacks presented by TCP, UDP and ICMP were insignificant. This result has supported the assumption that Honey Pot was able to help detecting the intrusion. In average, 16% of the attacks was detected by Honey Pot in every experiment.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an intelligent sensor network with cognitive technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: An intelligent wireless sensor network based on ZigBee technology with cognitive function is designed in this study. Sensors collect sensed data, include spectral parameters of 2.4G channels. These data are transmitted to coordinator by RF modules. ARM processor in the coordinator receives data. It gets the information of the idle channel and controls the channel conversion after the operation of the ARM processor. Cognitive results are sent to the host computer at the same time via the network port. Combining the characteristics of ZigBee, the machine learning method is applied to spectrum hole detection in ZigBee networks. By combining the cognitive radio sensing theory with the channel jamming theory, the spectrum holes with higher availability are used as the transmission channel, so that ZigBee can be more effectively transmitted without interference.

articleTitle: Scheduling optimization of islanded mode microgrid based on a charging/discharging strategy for storage batteries
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: To keep the economic and reliability of microgrid is a hot issue. There is the problem of the uncertainty of renewable energy generation as wind turbine (WT) and photovoltaic (PV), so batteries as energy storage devices play an important role in ensuring the safety and reliability of microgrid, especially the islanded mode microgrid. In order to optimize the scheduling of microgrid, a model consisting of WT, PV, fuel cell (FC), micro gas turbine (MT) and the storage battery (SB) is built. The objective of this scheduling optimization is to minimize the microgrid total operation cost and the pollution of environment. The constraints consider the energy supply and demand balance, climb rate constraints, and the battery charge or discharge capacity, etc. A charging/discharging strategy for SB is proposed, and simulation results indicate the strategy can effectively reduce both the economic and the environmental costs.

articleTitle: The reliability EMC design of WIA-PA wireless networks equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This paper to improve the security and reliability of the WIA-PA Wireless Networks Equipment, by analyzed the signal noise and surge in the environment of industrial and Outdoor. At last this paper propose one solution of the EMC protection circuit, and expounds the circuit principle of the WIA-PA Wireless Networks Equipment. The solution was tested by the IEC61000-4-5 level 3 and experimental verification, which can effectively improve the security and reliability of the equipment.

articleTitle: Improved trade-off characteristics of 3.3kV fast recovery diode with optimized carrier distribution used for power systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative method to optimize the excess carrier distribution in 3.3kV fast recovery diodes (FRDs). The idea is to develop a structure that can effectively optimize the anode emission efficiency. Based on TCAD simulation, two new structures, namely, local emitter control (LEC) diode, local emitter control and local lifetime control (LELC) diode, have been developed with improved trade-off characteristics between reverse recovery current peak and forward voltage drop compared with conventional diodes. The LEC diodes demonstrate the improved trade-off characteristics through introducing a wavy-type P-body that produces a low minority carrier density at P-body/N-sub side and a high minority carrier density at N-sub/N+ side. Through introducing an addition local lifetime control layer in combination with a wavy-type p-body, the LELC diode has demonstrated the best balanced properties of the forward voltage drop(V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">F</sub>), the reverse recovery current peak(I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rr</sub>), and the softness without at the expense of increasing leakage current. The forward voltage drop of LEC diode and LELC diode are respectively decreased by 23% and 35% compared with conventional diodes. The surge current of LELC diode is 2 times larger than that of conventional and LEC ones.

articleTitle: Control model of the roller shutter on cloudy days
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This paper introduces the mathematical model of office electric roller shutters movement tracks based on CIE overcast model and analyses factors affecting electric roller shutter height. The algorithm of roller shutters control and its application in intelligent building are put forward further. Building the space model, establishing the simulation model based on DIALux and calculating roller shutter height in model by MATLAB to get the trajectory calculation and simulation data of its movement tracks, which could achieve high precision by comparative analysis. When it is cloudy, regarding the window as a branch of the uniform surface light source to get desktop illumination calculation formula by measuring the window illumination and using the calculation formula of Lambertian radiator. And the error between calculation results and simulation results need to be kept below 5%. This kind of control algorithm can make full use of sunlight, in the meantime, it makes the office meet the illumination standard, which is green, energy-saving, practical and high precision.

articleTitle: Research on power quality disturbance source location of distribution network with distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: The power quality easily infuenced by the voltage sag, short circuit, noise engendered by the distribution network of the distributed generators, and the random power(harmonic wave) output derived from the electric source, leading the varied deviation and oscillation to the electric voltage and decreasing the stability of the operation of the lectric network. According to the topology structure of the distribution network of the distributed generators and the monitored information of the power quality, this paper proposed a disturbance locating model based on the Bayesian networks, analysing the changing rate of the node power output in the electric network and estimating the probablity of the anomaly of the disturbance in order to identify the position of the disturbance accurately. The experimental results illustrate that, with relative accuracy and fault-tolerance, the method proposed in this paper could locate the disturbance affecting the power quality of the distribution network of the distributed generators.

articleTitle: Optical spectra simulation for terahertz quantum cascade lasers based on a circuit-level model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: In this paper, a novel equivalent circuit model of terahertz quantum cascade lasers (THz QCLs) is introduced by virtue of revised three level multi-mode rate equations. This model accounts for influence of multi-mode on steady and optical spectra characteristics of THz QCLs. Both the photon gain coefficient and the spontaneous emission coupling coefficient depend on the wavelength in this model. The nonradiative scattering times, radiative spontaneous relaxation time and electron escape time are obtained by a self-consistent scheme. The model enables the analysis of the steady and optical spectra characteristics of THz QCL using general circuit analysis software, which overcomes the shortcomings of complex and long simulation time of numerical analysis method. Based on this novel model, the optical spectra characteristics as well as the optical power and bias voltage versus input current curves of a 2.4THz device with lattice temperature at 5K and 78K are investigated by using a circuit simulator (PSPICE). Results indicate that the model is practical and accurate for THz QCL simulation studying.

articleTitle: A new lossless compression scheme for large aperture static imaging spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method for the lossless compression of the interferometer hyperspectral instrument Large Aperture Static Imaging Spectrometer (LASIS) data is presented. This scheme rests upon the combination of data rearrangement and band ordering of LASIS three dimensional image and the recently presented CCSDS-123 lossless multispectral & Hyperspectral image compression standard. Firstly, the LASIS data is rearranged from the photo acquisition coordinate to the optical path difference (OPD) image coordinate by the rearrange approach to remove the interference information superimposed on the image. Then the OPD band is reordered according to the interferogram characteristic to improve the correlation between adjacent bands. Finally, the reordered OPD band data is processed using the CCSDS-123 standard. Several experiments were conducted to investigate the performance of the proposed compression scheme in the end. Experimental results suggest that this proposed compression scheme gives 31% higher compression ratio than using the standard alone.

articleTitle: Research on optimizing transparent clock's transfer for communication network of new intelligent substation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: In order to optimize the transparent clock's transfer process of the new intelligent substation's communication network and improve the shortcoming of P2P(peer-to-peer) TC(transparent clock) ranging process, reduce the design complexity and increase the system reliability, based on the principle of the IEEE 1588 V2 transparent clock synchronization, use the time synchronization of the EPON system to make the OLT and ONU equipment as a device, which is improving the method of transparent clock transfer in communication network and the accuracy of the delay measurement of the master and slave clocks, the problem of P2P ranging and dwell time correction are not supported between OLT equipment and PON port of ONU is solved.

Author Keywords: time synchronization of the EPON system

articleTitle: A supply modulator with fast mode transition for RF power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This paper describes a supply modulator for RF power amplifier capable of average-power-tracking (APT) mode and envelope-tracking (ET) mode. The supply modulator uses single controller and switched power stage for both modes and realizes short transitions of less than 10 μs, a required feature for air interface standards specified by 3GPP, such as LTE and 5G. Furthermore, the integrator-less controller minimizes order of the control system and accelerates transitions during APT mode.

articleTitle: Power optimization using Markov decision process based on multi-parameter constraint modeling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: Power optimization based on intelligent algorithm draws more and more attention. This article presents a novel low power optimization strategy based on the high level software power management employing Markov Process for charactering the real running workload. This article formulates workload characterization and selection with stochastic process method, and solves the formula using dynamic voltage frequency scaling base on microprocessor. Based on Markov process, the multi-parameter constraints has been employed to exploit the optimization space. Comparing with existing power optimization algorithm, our proposed power optimization algorithm doesn't need any prior data and maintains a value function representing expected reward. As many hardware events can be effectively captured and modeled, this optimization technique is capable to explore an ideal tradeoff in the constraint space.

articleTitle: Functional analysis of high-voltage cable simulation platform based on analog experiment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: According to the simulation experiment of high voltage cable defect, the simulation platform of high voltage cable is designed and built. The simulation platform includes booster unit, cable model unit, up flow unit and control unit, and integrates partial discharge, temperature, grounding current online monitoring device. The simulation platform can simulate and analyze all kinds of main insulation, semi-conducting layer, grounding system and insulation defect of high voltage cable. Through the analysis of the function of each component of the simulation platform, the simulation test ability of the platform is verified to ensure the accuracy and precision of the experiment results.

articleTitle: A low-power consumption 5GHz VCO based on BiCMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: A voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) for 5-GHz band application is presented in this paper. The VCO is designed for low voltage-supply, low power consumption, low phase noise and large tuning range based on TSMC 0.35μm SiGe BiCMOS process. To analyze the noise, the noise model of this design is deduced. The center frequency of VCO is 5.5GHz and oscillation frequency range is from 5.1 GHz to 5.9 GHz, that means tuning range is 14.5 %. With a supply voltage of 3.3 V, the dc power consumption is 2.9 mW. The phase noise is - 110 dBc/Hz at 1MHz offset.

articleTitle: Pl-servo with state-D feedback and observer for magnetic stirrer machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This paper presents PI-servo with a state-D feedback and observer designed for magnetic stirrer machine. Actually, the state variables cannot be directly measured that we need to feedback all state variables. Therefore, it is necessary to use an observer for the estimation of those state variables. The speed control DC motor for magnetic stirrer machine is compared between the Ogata's Method and PI-servo with State-D feedback and observer. The dynamic responses of a control system demonstrates effective the robustness and stability of a disturbance.

articleTitle: Analysis of ultra-short pulse modulation for NDIR
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: In this research an infrared source which radiation is modulated by supplying the heater of source with an ultrashort alternating voltage are used in gas analyzer operating on the basis of non-dispersive infrared sensing. Beyond the conventional technique of constant periodic heating of infrared light source, we propose a new infrared delta-sigma architecture with closed-loop feedback system is built with the hybrid combination of a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> infrared sensor with a specific wavelength filter, an infrared MEMS heater, a chopper amplifier, threshold comparator, ARM based MPU and discrete electronic devices. The thermal properties of light source for ultra-short alternating modulation without the use of a mechanical chopper has been studied from the output signal of infrared sensor within the limit of modulation frequency and energetic efficiency. The numbers of heating and cooling of the heater are count and manipulated to give a ratio which will determine the gas concentration. After a modeling of system, we built a model for the description of relationship between gas concentration and sensor by the duty of heating. The measurement results show a good linear behavior of signal and it proves to be a practical for all the NDIR measuring techniques and this work also gives a new approach not only to measure gas concentration fast but also obtain the high resolution.

articleTitle: A decoupling-capacitor free and enlarged-ICMR ECG readout circuit using offset feedback cancelling and charge pump-sustained input stage techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This paper presents an improved indirect feedback instrumentation amplifier for reading ECG signals. The circuit uses a charge pump module and an integral feedback offset suppression module. The input common mode range (ICMR) is extended, and the electrode offset and baseline drift in the ECG signal are suppressed. The circuit is designed by using 0.18μm CMOS process. The simulation shows that the circuit can operate at the input offset voltage 200mV at the 2V supply voltage. The input common mode range is 0∼3.4v, the gain is 46dB, the power consumption is 121.6μW, and the common mode rejection ratio is 124dB.

articleTitle: Sensor platform system based on graphical monitoring and control techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: The aim of this study was to develop a temperature-sensing USB I/O sensor platform system based on graphical monitoring and control techniques. Simple installation, built-in signal conditioning, and free supporting software make our USB I/O interface extremely easy-to-use. Additionally, this paper shed light on the contribution of applying the platform system for teaching students to understand the principles, functions, and applications of a temperature sensor and providing user experiences for them to acquire how to put it to use. Specifically, students used this platform to design a graphical program in advance to monitor the temperature sensor modules. The most important part of the proposed system is the implementation of the experimental USB I/O module in laboratory sessions.

articleTitle: Research on leakage reactance of zero sequence filter based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: Due to the windings of zero sequence filter are linked with zigzag connection, the zero sequence leakage reactance is the key parameter that affects the effect of the zero sequence filter. The simulation of two-dimensional leakage magnetic field in one phase of 100kVA zero sequence filter were implemented by using finite element analysis software-ANSYS, through pre-processing, solving and post-processing, the distribution of the magnetic field in the core of the zero sequence filter, the leakage magnetic field distribution between iron core and winding and the leakage magnetic field distribution between internal and external windings were obtained, then the zero sequence leakage reactance was calculated by the magnetic field energy method. This analysis provides a new idea of reducing the short-circuit impedance of zero-sequence filter and improving the filtering effect, and it can achieve purposes of shortening the design cycle and saving design cost.

Author Keywords: the distribution of leakage magnetic field

articleTitle: A novel flip-flop circuit for sub-threshold application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel sub-threshold flip-flop circuit with ultra-low voltage and ultra-low power - Half Clocked Master-Slave Logic (HCMSL). This circuit is optimized from the C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>MOS circuit and pseudo NMOS ratioed logic style and composed of pre-driving stage and output stage. Compared to conventional flip-flop circuits, it has comparative static power consumption and its output capacitance decreases a lot and the performance is also improved when it working in sub-threshold region. The circuit was simulated as well as the conventional flip-flop circuits in CMOS 130nm. In simulation it indicates 30%-70% less delay than conventional flip-flops and less power consumption when the logic activity exceeds 200 kHz.

articleTitle: A user cost and convenience oriented EV charging and discharging scheduling algorithm in V2G based microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: With the popularity of electric vehicles (EV), the power grid is facing with heavy load pressure, and the charging costs of users may also increase. V2G technology is an effective way to deal with this problem by the power interaction between EVs and power grid. As a relatively small, independent, power generation and load controllable system, microgrid is suitable for V2G deployment. In this paper, a user cost and convenience oriented electric vehicle charging and discharging scheduling (UCC-CDS) algorithm is proposed in V2G based microgrid that deploys lots of renewable energy resources. First, we discuss the infrastructure and organization structure of the V2G based microgrid. Second, a user cost and convenience oriented EV charging and discharging model is established while considering the optimal balance of user cost and convenience. Finally, the UCC-CDS algorithm is proposed while dividing the whole day into dozens of time slots and scheduling the charging and discharging operations in these time slots. Simulation results show that our algorithm can preferentially guarantee the user convenience and minimize the economic cost, while balancing the power load of microgrid by utilizing the renewable energy resources sufficiently.

articleTitle: Minterm based synthesis and optimization of asynchronous dual-rail encoded functional modules
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: As the feature size of semiconductor technology continues to scale down, conventional synchronous circuit design methods encounter more and more design challenges, one of which is the routing of global clock trees meeting timing and power requirements. Asynchronous circuits, which do not rely on global synchronization, provide alternative opportunities to their synchronous counterparts. This paper targets one class of asynchronous circuits with dual-rail encoded data and a high level of timing robustness. Transistor-level optimization methods are introduced to reduce the complexity of functional modules designed with traditional min-term based synthesis methods, while still preserving the timing robustness level. With the methods introduced in this paper, a wide spectrum of dual-rail encoded functional modules can be implemented in a design library for the asynchronous circuit synthesis with further area and performance optimization.

articleTitle: Scheduling of non-preemptive strictly periodic tasks in multi-core systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Circuits, Devices and Systems (ICCDS)
abstract: The problem of scheduling and allocation of non-preemptive strictly periodic tasks in multi-core systems mainly appears in large-scale real-time multi-core systems with strict constraints on time. Although the use of multi-core platform makes greatly improvement on computing power and reliability of electronic systems, it also enhances the complexity of the task scheduling and allocation issues. In the non-preemptive strictly periodic task scheduling research of multi-core system, how to use a minimized number of processors to meet the task execution conditions is an important issue. Based on existing schedulability analysis and related algorithms, we propose the Sequential Task Assignment Algorithm (STAA) to solve the problem of how to minimize the number of processors for non-preemptive strictly periodic real-time tasks in the multi-core system under non-overlapping constraints. We also give formulas based on Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) to calculate the minimum number of processors and the proposed MILP algorithm can get the optimal solution to the problem. Simulation results show that for randomly generated task sets, the STAA is superior to the existing algorithm in efficiency and results and is more efficient than the MILP algorithm and have a small difference in results.
